acceptanceCriteria: Homepage makes floor lamps the primary shopping path.
Visitors can browse all lamp categories and search products.
Product prices and cart totals display in BDT.
Visitors can add, remove, and adjust products in a persistent demo cart.
Layout is responsive and keyboard accessible.
Collections is a separate page linked from the main navigation, featuring floor lamps and all six categories.
Collection cards filter the product edit, with matching result counts and functional sorting.
The supplied Facebook profile is linked in the footer.
Shop is a separate modern page connected from the home and Collections navigation.
Shop filters combine correctly, remain visible as removable chips, and persist in shareable URLs.
Visitors can inspect product details, save products, and add to the shared bag without leaving the listing.
The Shop page supports desktop and mobile layouts, accessible dialogs, and useful empty states.
Our Approach is a dedicated brand-matched page linked from site navigation and story calls to action.
The Approach page explains lighting philosophy, provides an accessible room-lighting guide, and connects to Shop and Collections.
The Approach page works on mobile and desktop with the existing shared cart and a functional search-to-Shop form.
Journal is a dedicated brand-matched editorial page linked from every main navigation and footer.
Visitors can filter Journal stories by topic and open readable, directly linkable articles with useful next steps.
Journal and its article reader are responsive, keyboard accessible, and integrated with the shared bag and search.
Shop products, filters, search, saved pieces, and bag work when shop.html is opened directly using file:// as well as over HTTP.
Header search displays debounced inline product suggestions with images and BDT prices, supports AJAX retry and keyboard navigation, and hides the native blue cancel icon.
Homepage social section and all footer Follow links use the supplied Pinterest, Facebook, and YouTube URLs.
Homepage strip repeats continuously left to right without gaps and supports pause and reduced motion.
Homepage includes an accessible review section with clearly labeled sample content, responsive cards, and working links to related lamp categories.
Shared navigation stays visible while scrolling on desktop and mobile; search, bag, mobile menu, anchors, and sticky Shop controls remain accessible.
Product URLs resolve the selected lamp; gallery, quantity, saved pieces, shared bag and shop entry links work on desktop and mobile.
All pages replace checkout with email/Facebook enquiries; generated order details track bag quantities and totals; no submission or payment confirmation is shown when a contact app is opened.
